shared_elements: royal figure with distinctive elongated skull and facial profile
justification: Both depict a human head in strict profile with a tall elaborate crown and a cobra at the brow, rendered with the same conventions of exaggerated profile (long chin, slanted eye, elongated skull) and accompanied by script-like signs, which is a specific shared figural convention. However, A shows only a single large bust in a fragmentary close-up with a wavy border, while B presents a full multi-figure round-topped scene with a rayed sun disc, offering tables, several attendant figures and many registers of text, so the compositional relationships and arrangement barely correspond.
